name: Corporate & Commercial Advisory
shortDesc: Governance, contract management and business structuring for enterprises that are actively growing.
detail: Corporate governance, legal compliance and risk management; contract management; business valuation, accounting and auditing support; business structuring and restructuring; ESOP solutions; international trade advisory.

name: Transactions & Strategic Advisory
shortDesc: Business advisory and transaction structuring across every stage of the deal lifecycle.
detail: Domestic and cross-border transaction structuring; contract drafting and review; financing and investment support; real estate and employment-linked transaction advisory; strategic business advisory across the deal lifecycle.

name: Contracts & Agreements
shortDesc: Drafting, negotiation and review of commercial contracts and shareholder agreements.
detail: Employment and sales contracts, lease agreements, partnership deeds, AOA/MOA and other corporate documents, shareholder agreements, NDAs, settlement and arbitration agreements, powers of attorney.

name: Joint Ventures
shortDesc: Structuring and documentation for joint ventures and strategic alliances.
detail: Structuring and negotiation of joint ventures and strategic alliances, JV agreements, governance arrangements between partners, and dispute-avoidance mechanisms built into the documentation from the outset.
iconSvg: <circle cx="9" cy="12" r="6"/><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="6" opacity="0.55"/>

name: Mergers & Acquisitions
shortDesc: Due diligence, valuation and deal structuring, through to post-transaction integration.
detail: Pre-transaction due diligence and valuation; negotiation of purchase, merger and shareholder agreements, NDAs and letters of intent; regulatory compliance and financing; post-transaction integration and governance.

name: Cross-Border Transactions
shortDesc: International contracts, trade compliance, and cross-border M&A and financing.
detail: International contract drafting and review, trade compliance, cross-border M&A and foreign investment structuring, regulatory approvals, tax planning, and currency and exchange-control considerations.

name: Funding & Investments
shortDesc: Loan agreements, equity and debt fundraising, and investment transaction support.
detail: Loan agreements and debt fundraising, equity and securities offerings, pre- and post-IPO advisory, employee stock option plans, and fintech and digital-securities advisory.

name: Employment, HR & POSH
shortDesc: Contracts, policies and disciplinary matters, including POSH / ICC investigations.
detail: Employment contracts, offer and appointment letters, handbooks and policies, disciplinary proceedings and terminations, union and workplace-safety matters, and full POSH services including external ICC membership, awareness training and inquiry reports.

name: Compliance & Regulatory Support
shortDesc: Corporate, HR and data-privacy compliance, board resolutions and regulatory filings.
detail: Corporate secretarial compliance, board resolutions and governance, regulatory filings and licensing, HR and data-privacy compliance, contract lifecycle management, and SEBI and stock-exchange compliance advisory.

name: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
shortDesc: Litigation, arbitration, mediation and settlement negotiation to protect business interests.
detail: Civil and criminal litigation, arbitration and mediation, recovery proceedings including Section 138 matters, settlement negotiations, and police-complaint and FIR assistance, always weighed against what protects the business.

name: Due Diligence
shortDesc: Transaction, property and counterparty diligence with clear, decision-ready reporting.
detail: Document, litigation and regulatory-compliance review; intellectual-property and employment/labour review; environmental due diligence; risk assessment reporting for transactions, property and counterparties.

name: Intellectual Property Rights
shortDesc: Trademark, copyright and patent registration, portfolio management and infringement action.
detail: Trademark, patent and copyright searches, filing and prosecution; enforcement and infringement litigation; trade-secret protection; IP portfolio management, audits, licensing strategy and anti-counterfeiting action.

name: Real Estate & Property Matters
shortDesc: Property transactions, title diligence, leasing and real estate dispute resolution.
detail: Purchase, sale and lease agreements; title searches and due diligence; development and construction agreements (JV, BBA, ATS); landlord-tenant matters; real estate litigation, mediation and arbitration; regulatory compliance and registration.

name: Private Client & Family Matters
shortDesc: Wills, family and matrimonial matters, and personalised advisory for individuals.
detail: Wills, trusts and estate planning; family law including divorce, custody and matrimonial disputes; personal real estate and property matters; individual dispute resolution and litigation support; reputation and defamation matters.

name: Legal Opinions
shortDesc: Considered legal opinions to support complex or high-stakes business decisions: often where the other areas begin.
detail: Considered, written legal opinions to support high-stakes business decisions, board resolutions and transaction sign-off, drawing on the other fourteen practice areas as the matter requires.
